title: three.ws standalone mirrors
description: One entry per monorepo directory that has (or could have) a public, generated, read-only GitHub mirror. scripts/sync-standalone-repos.mjs and the other exporters (export-growth-satellites.mjs, build-awesome.mjs, build-standalone-skill-repos.mjs) read this manifest instead of hardcoding repo names. The monorepo stays the canonical source; mirrors are one-way snapshots.

repo.description: GitHub repo slug under github.com/nirholas (owner implied), or null when no mirror exists yet.

path.description: Directory in this monorepo, relative to the repo root.

direction.description: "out": this monorepo directory is exported to the mirror. "in": the mirror (or an external repo) is the source of truth and this directory is a reference copy.

exporter.description: Which script produces/consumes this mirror: sync-standalone-repos.mjs, export-growth-satellites.mjs, export-satellites.mjs, build-awesome.mjs --standalone, or build-standalone-skill-repos.mjs.

npm.description: Published npm package name for this path, or null when it is not an npm package.
